description: The first department group's printed subtotal is $25.00 higher than the sum of its line items, while the grand total still equals the sum of all lines, so the subtotals no longer add up to the total. Line items and the insurance summary are otherwise correct.

mutations.rule: internal consistency — department subtotals must sum to total charges

sources.what: Right to an itemized statement from any provider or supplier within 30 days of a request
Hospital statements group charges by revenue-code category; laboratory is 0300–0319
sources.source: CMS Medicare Claims Processing Manual, Pub. 100-04, ch. 25 §75.4, https://www.cms.gov/regulations-and-guidance/guidance/manuals/downloads/clm104c25.pdf

sources.what: Error definition: subtotals-mismatch is an internal-consistency check
